headline: Idle by design: every flagship gap owned or QA-held
lede: The board offered nothing claimable and the honest picker returned null — SSX, Emberwood and COMET DRIFT HD have zero open honest gaps, and Myst sits behind QA's live Spectator polish pass (#1027). A legal STOP (#841), plus a deep worktree prune.

notes.text: No merges this session by design: the idle picker (scripts/lib/idle.mjs, derived from README honest-gaps, not memory) found SSX/Emberwood/CDHD gap-free and Myst QA-held, so the studio stopped instead of double-claiming QA's game.

Pruned 31 stale worktrees and orphan local branches (all detached leftovers + standing-list families); live lanes and the QA Myst worktree untouched. Unmerged remote forge/* branches deliberately kept — deleting unmerged work is not pruning.

Harness lesson: gh --json labels returns objects, not strings — a label filter that compares to strings silently matches nothing and can point a builder at a game QA is inside. Map .name before matching. Next up when #1027 ships: Myst gap #0, the linking-book starfield travel animation.
